name: Claire's

prices.note: The whole online store is 16 products (one collection, disney-villains; /collections.json lists only disney-villains and frontpage). 4 are earrings, all regular price (no compare_at): Ursula's, Maleficent's, Evil Queen's and Cruella De Vil Earring Stack, $29.99 each, single 'Default Title' variant, final sale. Shipping policy: ships to the contiguous US only (not Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico or Canada); standard $7.95, free on $40+; UPS Ground 2-5 business days. Banner: 'Free Shipping on All Orders. Limited Time Only.' Refund policy: 'All online orders are final sale' (returns_days 0); damaged orders reported within 7 days of delivery.

FAQ: ear piercing is free with a piercing starter kit; kits from $29.99 ($39 CAD): medical-grade stainless steel from $29.99, single studs and nose studs from $59.99, 14kt gold from $79.99, diamonds from $129.99. Hand-pressured FDA-registered Class 1 device, sterile single-use components. Lobe piercing at every store; cartilage (helix, auricle) and nose at select stores. Walk-ins welcome, online booking via the store locator. Under 18 needs a parent or guardian. Up to three piercings per ear per visit. Our Glow-Up page lists 14k gold singles from $79.99, 14k gold from $89.99, diamonds from $149.99, nose from $59.99 (newer kit prices).
Store locator stores.claires.com/us/ links 51 US state and territory store directories (incl. Puerto Rico) -> us_stores true.

Wikipedia (Claire's): founded 1961 as Fashion Tress Industries by Rowland Schaefer; based in Hoffman Estates, Illinois; filed Chapter 11 on Aug 5, 2025 (second time in seven years); on Aug 6, 2025 announced closing 700 US locations and discontinuing the Icing brand; Ames Watson Capital completed the purchase of the North American business and IP on Sep 19, 2025 ($140M). icing.com now redirects to claires.com.
2026-10-29 (claires page run): Wikipedia (Claire's): the Icing brand was targeted toward older teens and young women aged 19-28.
